dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, did you see the news? The police arrested a man at the night market.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈsiː ðə ˈnuːz? ðə pəˈliːs əˈrɛstɪd ə ˈmæn ət ðə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He had stolen more than fifty phones from tourists.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː hæd ˈstoʊlən ˈmɔːr ðən ˈfɪfti ˈfoʊnz frəm ˈtʊrɪsts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A tourist saw him and called the police. They came quickly, but the criminal had already escaped.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈtʊrɪst ˈsɔː hɪm ənd ˈkɔːld ðə pəˈliːs. ðeɪ ˈkeɪm ˈkwɪkli, bʌt ðə ˈkrɪmɪnəl hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ɪˈskeɪpt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So how did they arrest him?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈhaʊ dɪd ðeɪ əˈrɛst hɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They found him the next day. He had hidden in a friend's house.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈfaʊnd hɪm ðə ˈnɛkst ˈdeɪ. hiː hæd ˈhɪdən ɪn ə ˈfrɛndz ˈhaʊs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is stealing a serious crime in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ˈstiːlɪŋ ə ˈsɪriəs ˈkraɪm ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. It's illegal everywhere, and the law here is strict.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ɪˈliːɡəl ˈɛvriwɛr, ənd ðə ˈlɔː ˈhɪr ɪz ˈstrɪkt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. The police had arrested him twice before.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðə pəˈliːs hæd əˈrɛstɪd hɪm ˈtwaɪs bɪˈfɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I hope he stays away from the market now!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp hiː ˈsteɪz əˈweɪ frəm ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt ˈnaʊ!
